description: Na₃InS₃ is Ilmenite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four S atoms to form distorted NaS₄ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaS₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaS₄ tetrahedra, corners with five equivalent InS₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaS₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent NaS₄ trigonal pyramids, and  a faceface with one NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 36°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.75-2.83 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four S atoms to form distorted NaS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaS₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent InS₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent NaS₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaS₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one InS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-52°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.73-2.82 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaS₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent InS₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaS₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent NaS₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent InS₄ tetrahedra, and faces with two equivalent NaS₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.82-3.25 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.81-3.38 Å. In is bonded to four S atoms to form InS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent NaS₄ tetrahedra, corners with five equivalent NaS₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaS₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaS₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one InS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-51°. There are a spread of In-S bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.54 Å. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two equivalent In atoms. In the second S site, S is bonded to five Na and one In atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing SNa₅In pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-60°. In the third S site, S is bonded to five Na and one In atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₅In octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 15°.
